payload.title: Jev research articles: explicit we-do-this-for-you-at-scale closings
payload.description: Ryan, 2026-09-26, on /blog/fine-tuning-jev/: articles like this need to be a lot more explicit that Anthus can do this for you, at scale, with years of experience doing it. First pass: a bespoke closing section on fine-tuning-jev that reconciles the small repo demo with the production loop Anthus has run for years on Plexus; a more explicit shared engage box; and the client-acquisition tag on the Jev series so the box renders on each. Follow-up: bespoke closings on the other Jev articles in the same shape.
